I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`, and all 34 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass.

I also edited `tests/test_parser.py`, because two of its tests contradicted each other. `test_delete_with_and_without_where` expects `DELETE FROM t` to parse to `DeleteStmt("t", None)`. `test_delete_without_where_matches_all_rows` expected `DeleteStmt("t", Literal(True))` for the same input. Both can't pass. I changed the second one to expect `None`, which matches the `DeleteStmt` docstring ("no WHERE deletes every row") and the first test. If you wanted `Literal(True)` instead, the parser and the first test would need to change.

I only ran `tests/test_parser.py`, not the integration tests.
